name: docspp
description: Interactive and Declaritive Diagraming documentation Solution with playable scenarios

paragraphs: Describe a system in YAML. Get a clean, interactive diagram with markdown docs behind every box, and scenarios that show a request travelling through it, step by step.
Documentation · Playground · Live examples · Report a bug · Request a feature

Architecture diagrams go stale because they are pictures. docspp keeps the system as data, so the diagram, the docs and the walkthroughs come from one place that lives in your repository and changes in the same pull request as the code.
features: Playground. Write YAML with a live preview, or build nodes, groups and connections visually and export the YAML. Local drafts, undo/redo and examples included.
Declarative. Nodes, groups and edges in diagram.yaml. No coordinates: layout is automatic and steerable with a few hints.

Scenarios. Any number per diagram: the happy path, a cache miss, a declined card. Each plays as packets over the architecture, as a sequence diagram, or as a swimlane story, with a step list, scrubbing, speed control…
One model, many views. Write a node once; show it in an overview, a backend-only view, a per-team view.
Docs inside the picture. Click a box for its markdown, connections and source references. Edge keys link to an interfaces table generated from the model.
